title: pm-dispatch `lanes/mobile.md`: record the maintainer ruling that the mobile seat lands non-governed PRs through the merge queue
body:
repo:mobile#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnW1Xf6HDSWz1eGAqv

Filing category ③: a direct task carrying a maintainer ruling. The ruling is recorded on objectstack-ai/mobile#160, comment 6578710331.

## The ruling, verbatim

The maintainer answered three things, in the session `session_01QSeKYnW1Xf6HDSWz1eGAqv` on 2026-11-02:
- 「非受管 PR 由席位落地」. The question was: must every mobile PR wait for the maintainer's merge? Option 2 was "the seat lands non-governed PRs after ACCEPT".
- 「我改了配置 Allow auto-merge」
- 「合并对立额已经开了」, meaning the merge queue on `main` is on.

## What the charter says today

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/mobile.md`, under 常设承诺, says that a merge to `main` runs `eas-build.yml` and `eas-update.yml`, which are treated as release actions. It concludes: 「本仓 PR 的合并恒归维护者」.

## What changed on the platform (measured on objectstack-ai/mobile)

| Item | State |
| --- | --- |
| `allow_auto_merge` | `true` |
| Ruleset on `main` | `merge_queue` plus required check `Lint & Type Check` |
| `merge_group` triggers in `ci.yml` and `lint-typecheck.yml` | Added by objectstack-ai/mobile#172 |
| First seat landing | objectstack-ai/mobile#166 merged through the queue as `0fd7113` |
| EAS Build and EAS Update on `main` | Every build and publish step is `skipped`, because `EXPO_TOKEN` is unset |

## Ask

Amend `lanes/mobile.md` so the charter states the ruling and its terms. These are the terms the seat has operated under since the ruling (seat post comment above):

1. After ACCEPT, the seat lands a PR whose path surface is not governed and whose checks are green on the current head. It marks the PR ready and enables auto-merge, which enqueues it.
2. These PRs stay with the maintainer:
   - governed-surface PRs;
   - `.github/workflows/**` PRs, even though the register does not list mobile's workflows.
3. Release actions stay human: `eas-submit.yml`, store submission and version cuts.
4. Guard: before each landing, the seat reads the latest EAS Build and Update runs on `main`. If any build or publish step actually ran, which means `EXPO_TOKEN` is configured and a merge now pushes OTA to installed apps, the seat stops landing and asks the maintainer for a new ruling.
5. Device checks still go to the maintainer in 维护者速读. Landing does not mean device-verified.

Remove or rewrite the 「本仓 PR 的合并恒归维护者」 conclusion accordingly. The id-lint rule applies: no issue numbers in the operational text.

## Who acts

The `domain:skills` seat. `.claude/**` is Tier S under the governed rules (contract-review-tier review, then the queue). The mobile seat does not edit this file.

## Duplicate check (2026-11-02)

`is:issue "lanes/mobile.md"` in this repo returned 0 hits. The lane was registered the same day.
